cover.open.note: Leaf 0: the cover lifts off the page block, a short dry friction; the swing itself stays silent (a long swipe read as a filtered-noise sweep; the bank has no creak)

cover.thud.note: Leaf 0 lands flat: a soft thud on a book at the fit's own size (CLAP's best for 'a hardcover book being closed')

cover.slap.note: layer: the dry klack of the board edge, upper body of the thud (no sub)

air.note: the short breath of air a heavy cover pushes out as it lands (layer under the thuds; cloth, not velvet: less sub-bass)

sheet.note: Leaf 1: one thin sheet turned over

glide.note: Title page pop-up: the long listing slides back over the agent into the KI's slot (the usual way); one soft glide, its peak in the pause after "Nein"

slip.note: Title page pop-up: the small result slip slides into the KI (Code Mode), a short light flick after "Endergebnis": the counterpart of the long glide

turn.note: Boards 2-6: the heavy card leaf swinging over, its fastest point (easeTurn 2.1u^2-1.1u^3: about 0.55 of the turn)

turn.b.note: the same swing in the crisper paper member, so the five board turns alternate

standup.note: second half of a board turn: the dry rustle of the paper scene standing up; take 4 for the message card on spread 7, take 5 for the sandbox on spread 5

standup.b.note: the same rustle, lighter, for the alternate boards

lock.note: where a scene locks: a short soft knock with a small body and no note; take 3 for the sandbox frame

lock.b.note: a second lock knock: a fingertip on a book (fit of a real recording); take 2 for the message card

lock.c.note: a third lock knock, drier and shorter

click.note: a tiny click layered on some locks: the cardboard tab seating

plug.note: spread 3: a plug seating itself in its plate, seven in a row 0.4 s apart; a tiny dry latch without a note (CLAP: a plug into a socket z 1.8-2.3, ahead of keyboard and shutter)

flap.note: spread 4 "Runde": the brass flap over the round counter swings open, release, travel and stop (CLAP reads it as a door latch, z 2.7; quiet enough not to read as a camera)

tick.note: the round counter on spreads 4 and 5 turning one digit on: a very soft wooden tick (CLAP: as close to a counter as toggle/micro, and a different material from the plugs)

cover.close.note: Leaf 7: the back cover lifts off, a short dry friction; the swing stays silent

book.shut.note: the closed book: a soft, full thud at the fit's own size (the lowered size and a tap/soft sub layer read as a bass drum)

book.slap.note: layer: the boards meeting, the dry klack over the thud (no sub)
